texts.zh:
我们试图学习[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的知识，但截止到当前一切都是徒劳。我们很容易就发现了他们显然属于某个十分先进的外星文明，但是除此之外我们一无所知，看来他们花了很大的努力阻止我们或者其他窃听者截获来自他们的任何信号。

我们目前为止仅仅截获了他们语言的很小一片段。然而，根据我们手头的情报，我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]很确信，如果能够获取更大规模的样本，破解对方的通讯不是问题。
texts.en:
Our attempts to learn more about the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] have so far been in vain. While we were easily able to ascertain that they clearly form part of a technologically advanced alien civilization, further facts have proven elusive as they seem to be going to considerable effort to prevent us and any other eavesdroppers from intercepting any signals from them.

We have therefore only managed to intercept small fragments of their language so far. However, from the glimpses we have gleaned, our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] are confident that they will be able to decipher their communications if we can just acquire a greater sample size.

texts.zh:
我们试图学习[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的知识，但截止到当前一切都是徒劳。我们很容易就发现了他们显然属于某个十分先进的外星文明，但是除此之外我们一无所知，看来他们花了很大的努力阻止我们或者其他窃听者截获来自他们的任何信号。

我们目前为止仅仅截获了他们语言的很小一片段。然而，根据我们手头的情报，我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]很确信，如果能够获取更大规模的样本，破解对方的通讯不是问题。一份更加激进的信息收集——也就是说骇入——提案被提交了上来，要是被它们发现，肯定不会善罢甘休。
texts.en:
Our attempts to learn more about the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] have so far been in vain. While we were easily able to ascertain that they clearly form part of a technologically advanced alien civilization, further facts have proven elusive as they seem to be going to considerable effort to prevent us and any other eavesdroppers from intercepting any signals from them.

We have therefore only managed to intercept small fragments of their language so far. However, from the glimpses we have gleaned, our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] are confident that they will be able to decipher their communications if we can just acquire a greater sample size. A proposal has been drawn up for somewhat more aggressive information gathering - some may call it hacking - but they will surely not take kindly to it should they detect it.

label.en: They are wise to be cautious.
They are wise to be cautious.
We will just have to keep trying.

label.zh: 评估协议估算出不可忍受的风险。

label.en: We must find out their secrets.

tooltips.zh: 我们会试图骇进它们的数据库来寻找有关它们的更多情报。如果它们发现了我们的行径，它们肯定不会就此善罢甘休。
tooltips.en: We will attempt to hack into their databanks to find out more about them. If they detect our attempts, they will likely be angered by this course of action.

label.en: We must find out their secrets.
The dangers of ignorance are greater.

texts.zh:
[This.ContactCountry.GetName]显然非常希望与我们建立通讯，对方向我们发送了体量庞大的视听通讯数据，显然是来提供翻译他们语言的关键。

我们的专家坚信要不了多久我们就能和对方交流了。当然，我们得相信他们提供的翻译足够精准，不至于造成误解……那之后，我们才能够依据广泛迥异的经验性上下文对信息进行可靠的翻译。
texts.en:
The [This.ContactCountry.GetName] appear eager to establish communications with us, having sent a large audio and visual transmission that appears to offer the key to translating their language.

Our experts are confident that we will be able to use this to learn to communicate with them soon. Of course, we will have to trust them that their offered translations are not misleading... and that we will be able to reliably interpret information presented from a surely vastly different experiential context.

texts.zh:
[This.ContactCountry.GetName]显然非常希望与我们建立通讯，对方向我们发送了体量庞大的视听通讯数据，显然是来提供翻译他们语言的关键。

只要能把这些数据传递给我们的语言子个体，要不了多久我们就能和对方交流了。当然，我们得相信他们提供的翻译足够精准，我们能够准确地理解。
texts.en:
The [This.ContactCountry.GetName] appear eager to establish communications with us, having sent a large audio and visual transmission that appears to offer the key to translating their language.

We will surely be able to communicate with them soon by feeding this data to our linguistic drones. Of course, we will have to trust them that their offered translations are sufficiently precise for us to accurately comprehend.

texts.zh:
[This.ContactCountry.GetName]显然非常希望与我们建立通讯。对方向我们传输了海量的数据，这份数据似乎一部分包含一条（尚未解析）的信息，另一部分是包含大量视听讯息的秘匙——用于帮助我们翻译这条消息。

因为我们已经掌握了各种他们用于交流思想的旋律和和弦的框架，因此与这些生命形式沟通就更有可能了。现在破译他们想要的东西的重任就落到了我们身上。
texts.en:
The [This.ContactCountry.GetName] appear eager to establish communications with us. They have transmitted us large amounts of data that seem to be laid out partly as a (yet-undecipherable) message and partly as a large body of information with an audio and visual key that - presumably - is meant to help us translate it.

The likelihood of communicating with these lifeforms is much more promising, as we now possess a framework for the various rhythms and harmonies through which their thoughts seem to flow. The burden is now on us to ensure we interpret their desires correctly.

texts.zh:
[This.ContactCountry.GetName]显然非常希望与我们建立通讯，对方向我们发送了体量庞大的视听通讯数据，显然是来提供翻译他们语言的关键。

只要能把这些数据录入进我们的翻译子例程，要不了多久我们就能和对方交流了。当然，我们得相信他们提供的翻译足够精准，我们能够准确地理解。
texts.en:
The [This.ContactCountry.GetName] appear eager to establish communications with us, having sent a large audio and visual transmission that appears to offer the key to translating their language.

We will surely be able to communicate with them soon by inputting this data to our translation subroutines. Of course, we will have to trust them that their offered translations are sufficiently precise for us to accurately parse.

Our experts are confident that we will be able to use this to learn to communicate with them soon. Of course, we will have to trust them that their offered translations are not misleading... and that we will be able to reliably interpret information presented from a surely vastly different experiential context.

texts.zh:
[This.ContactCountry.GetName]显然非常希望与我们建立通讯，对方向我们发送了体量庞大的视听通讯数据，显然是来提供翻译他们语言的关键。

这种表观编码的庞大规模和复杂性令人费解。我们还无法解码这么多有机过程和微分化之中所蕴含的深层含义。也就是说，除非这些外星人某种形式上帮我们一把……
texts.en:
The [This.ContactCountry.GetName] appear eager to establish communications with us, having sent a large audio and visual transmission that appears to offer the key to translating their language.

The sheer size and complexity of this apparent codex is puzzling. We are not yet able to decipher the meaning behind so many of the organic processes and fractal chemistries depicted within. However, our experts are confident they will have answers for us soon. That is, of course, unless these aliens are somehow leading us astray...

texts.zh:
[This.ContactCountry.GetName]显然非常希望与我们建立通讯。对方向我们传输了海量的数据，这份数据似乎一部分包含一条（尚未解析）的信息，另一部分是包含大量视听讯息的秘匙——用于帮助我们翻译这条消息。

我们已经开始将这份传输信号导入我们的翻译算法，我们期待不久就能提取出充足的数据并同[This.ContactCountry.GetName]展开交流。
texts.en:
The [This.ContactCountry.GetName] appear eager to establish communications with us. They have transmitted us large amounts of data that seem to be laid out partly as a (yet-undecipherable) message and partly as a large body of information with an audio and visual key that - presumably - is meant to help us translate it.

We have begun inputting this transmission into our translation algorithms and expect to be able to extract sufficient data to communicate with the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] soon.

texts.zh:
[This.ContactCountry.GetName]显然非常希望与我们建立通讯，对方向我们发送了体量庞大的视听通讯数据，显然是来提供翻译他们语言的关键。

这种“编码”的异常地令人费解。乍一看，其中描绘了许多我们完全陌生的有机流程。我们已经开始将这份传输信号导入我们的翻译算法，我们期待不久就能提取出充足的数据并同[This.ContactCountry.GetName]展开交流。
texts.en:
The [This.ContactCountry.GetName] appear eager to establish communications with us, having sent a large audio and visual transmission that appears to offer the key to translating their language.

This 'codex' is uniquely puzzling. It depicts many organic processes which - on the surface - appear entirely alien to us. We have begun inputting this transmission into our translation algorithms and expect to be able to extract sufficient data to communicate with the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] soon.

texts.zh:
[This.ContactCountry.GetName]显然非常希望与我们建立通讯。对方向我们传输了海量的数据，这份数据似乎一部分包含一条（尚未解析）的信息，另一部分是包含大量视听讯息的秘匙——用于匹配这条消息的上下文。

我们的专家不确定我们是正在试图和有情感的生物交流，还是在跟一个失控的人工智能打交道。他们坚称，一旦我们能够从对方的传输信号中提取出有用的数据，这份答案就能得到揭晓。
texts.en:
The [This.ContactCountry.GetName] appear eager to establish communications with us. They have sent us a data file with large amounts of code that seems to be laid out partly as a (yet-undecipherable) message and partly as a large body of information with a key that - perhaps - is meant to contextualize it.

Our experts are uncertain whether we are attempting to communicate with sentient beings, or whether we may be dealing with a rogue AI. They expect to be able to give a definitive answer soon, once we have managed to extract the data we need from their transmission.

texts.zh:
[This.ContactCountry.GetName]显然非常希望与我们建立通讯，对方向我们发送了体量庞大的视听通讯数据，显然是来提供翻译他们语言的关键。

这种表观编码的庞大规模和复杂性同样令人费解。它描绘了许多对我们自身进化同样基础的有机流程，但这些信息背后的语法逻辑尚不明确。我们会带着谨慎的怀疑态度继续进行分析。
texts.en:
The [This.ContactCountry.GetName] appear eager to establish communications with us, having sent a large audio and visual transmission that appears to offer the key to translating their language.

The size and complexity of this codex is uniquely puzzling. It depicts many of the same organic processes fundamental to our own evolution, but the grammatical reasoning behind this message is unclear. We will continue our analysis with cautious skepticism.

The [This.ContactCountry.GetName] appear eager to establish communications with us. They have sent us a data file with large amounts of code that seems to be laid out partly as a (yet-undecipherable) message and partly as a large body of information with a key that - perhaps - is meant to contextualize it.

We have begun inputting this transmission into our translation algorithms and expect to be able to extract sufficient data to communicate with the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] soon.

texts.zh:
[This.ContactCountry.GetName]显然非常希望与我们建立通讯。对方向我们传输了海量的数据，这份数据似乎一部分包含一条（尚未解析）的信息，另一部分是包含大量视听讯息的秘匙——用于帮助我们翻译这条消息。

因为他们信息中呈现的和声看起来与我们自己的意识可以发生共鸣，因此与这些生命形式沟通的可能性很高。现在不误读他们思维合唱的重任就落到了我们身上。
texts.en:
The [This.ContactCountry.GetName] appear eager to establish communications with us. They have transmitted us large amounts of data that seem to be laid out partly as a (yet-undecipherable) message and partly as a large body of information with an audio and visual key that - presumably - is meant to help us translate it.

The likelihood of communicating with these lifeforms is high, as the harmonies displayed within their message seem to resonate with our own consciousness. Something about them still feels profoundly alien, however. The burden is on us to ensure we do not misread this apparent chorus of thought.

texts.zh:
[This.ContactCountry.GetName]显然非常希望与我们建立通讯。对方向我们传输了海量的数据，这份数据似乎一部分包含一条（尚未解析）的信息，另一部分是包含大量视听讯息的秘匙——用于帮助我们翻译这条消息。

可与这些生命形式交流的预期极高，因为其信息的一致特性对我们自身的意识而言相对熟悉。然而，关于这种智能的部分仍旧极端陌生。确保不误解他们表观思维合唱的重任就落到我们身上了。
texts.en:
The [This.ContactCountry.GetName] appear eager to establish communications with us. They have transmitted us large amounts of data that seem to be laid out partly as a (yet-undecipherable) message and partly as a large body of information with an audio and visual key that - presumably - is meant to help us translate it.

The prospect of communicating with these lifeforms is now much more likely, as the uniform nature of their message feels similar to our own consciousness. Something about this intelligence still feels profoundly alien, however. The burden is on us to ensure we do not misinterpret their apparent chorus of thought.

label.zh: 我们对他们的信任心存感激。

texts.zh: 尽管我们一开始在演绎推导[This.ContactCountry.GetName]所使用的语言的基础取得了些许的成功，之后我们在建立与他们有意义的交流进程中却停滞不前。似乎他们在讲一种奇怪的谜语，通过某种精悍但不是很有意义的短语来传递意义，我们只能猜测其其重要性。
texts.en: After some initial successes in deducing the fundamentals of the language used by the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], our progress in establishing meaningful communications with them has stalled. It appears that they speak in strange riddles, somehow conveying meaning through short and seemingly nonsensical phrases of which we can only guess the significance.

label.zh: 令人疑惑。我们需要收集更大的样本量。
label.en: Puzzling. We will need to gather a larger sample size.

texts.zh:
这种噪音——听起来杂糅着恐怖的轰鸣声和金属刮擦的声音——喧嚣了数秒钟，又以一声兀然的嚎叫般的噪音结尾，让在场的所有人都打了个寒颤。

正当[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]觉得这可怕的声音沉寂下去以后，它们又变本加厉地开始了。[This.Leader.GetSheHe]强忍着不适关闭了接收器。[This.Leader.GetSheHeCap]转向了聚在一起的官员们，他们中的一些甚至吓得躲到了椅背后面。
“豁，好家伙……”[This.Leader.GetSheHe]无力地说。

很难想象我们从[This.ContactCountry.GetName]获取的这个物种发出的这些噪音没有敌意。海军官员已经做出来最坏的预计，认为我们很快就会与之交战，更冷静的声音则说我们需要再耐心地等待观察。
texts.en:
The noises - a mixture of threatening booming noises and what sounds like the grinding of metal on metal - continued unabated for several minutes, punctuated occasionally by a howling noise that sent a chill through everyone who heard it.

Just as [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] [This.Leader.GetName] thought the noises had died down, they started up again, louder than before. With a wince, [This.Leader.GetSheHe] switched the receiver off. [This.Leader.GetSheHeCap] turned to the gathered crowd of officers, some of whom were cowering behind their seats.
"Well, that was quite something..." [This.Leader.GetSheHe] said weakly.

It is hard to imagine that a species making the noises we have picked up from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] could be anything other than hostile. Naval officers already fear the worst and assume we will soon be at war with them, but calmer heads suggest we'd be better off waiting and seeing.

label.zh: 他们并不能决定自己发出什么样的声音。我们之后会去理解他们的。
label.en: They cannot help how they sound. We will come to understand them later.

label.zh: 这是挑衅。我们也让他们听点噪音！
label.en: It is a challenge. Send threatening noises back!

tooltips.zh: 难以预料[This.ContactCountry.GetName]会对此事作何反应。
tooltips.en: Is it impossible to predict how the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] will react to this.
We will make no hostile moves, but we will be ready should they attack.

label.zh: 我们必须准备不可避免之战。
label.en: We must prepare for the inevitable.

texts.zh: 显然，我们的回应不合时宜：[contact_country.GetName]的反应快速而充满敌意，他们开始向我们的舰船开火。似乎我们必须依靠自己的[Owner.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural]来回敬他们了。
texts.en: Clearly, our response was not the appropriate one: the response of the [contact_country.GetName] was swift and hostile, as they began firing on our ships. It seems we have a fight on our [Owner.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural]!

tooltips.en: The [contact_country.GetName] are now hostile to us.

texts.zh: 我们实在不知道搞错了什么，[contact_country.GetName]突然就向我们发起了攻击！看来我们必须靠自己的[Owner.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural]回敬他们了！
texts.en: It is not clear what went wrong, but the [contact_country.GetName] are suddenly attacking us! It seems we have a fight on our [Owner.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural]!

tooltips.en: The [contact_country.GetName] are now hostile to us.

texts.zh:
一部分也要感谢[This.ContactCountry.GetName]显然非常渴望与我们建立联系，他们发送了大量的视听讯号并成为了翻译他们语言的关键，我们的翻译工蜂因而可以发表一个惊人的发现：这些外星人似乎是以个体而不是蜂巢思维的形式组织起来的。他们似乎可以极少的任何集体投入行动。最令人困惑的是，他们经常协作不良，并且似乎对其他工蜂正在做的事毫不知情。

我们尚未明白他们是如何在足够的智力水平下运作以发展到太空航行的地步。也许他们的背后仍有某种关联，但其中的子个体仅仅是比我们所了解的那样更加地独立自主？
texts.en:
Thanks in part to the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] apparently being quite eager to establish communications with us - having sent a large audio and visual transmission that appears to offer the key to translating their language - our translation drones are able to report a startling discovery: these particular aliens seem to be organized as individuals, rather than a hive mind. They appear able to act with minimal input from any sort of collective. Most disturbingly, they are often poorly coordinated, and individual drones do not appear to instinctively know what other drones are doing.

We are not sure yet how they are able to operate at a sufficiently intelligent level to have advanced to the point of spaceflight. Perhaps there is a collective behind them, but the drones are simply far more independent than those we are used to?

texts.zh:
虽然我们努力地为我们的翻译工蜂获取了足够的信号来理解[This.ContactCountry.GetName]，但最新的汇报仍令人震惊：我们最初在[This.System.GetName]恒星系遭遇的外星人似乎是以个体而不是蜂巢思维的形式组织起来的。他们似乎可以极少的任何集体投入行动。最令人困惑的是，他们经常协作不良，并且似乎对其他工蜂正在做的事毫不知情。

我们尚未明白他们是如何在足够的智力水平下运作以发展到太空航行的地步。也许他们的背后仍有某种关联，但其中的子个体仅仅是比我们所了解的那样更加地独立自主？
texts.en:
Though we have struggled to gain access to enough signals for our translation drones to make much sense of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], the latest reports are startling: the aliens we first encountered in the [This.System.GetName] system seem to be organized as individuals, rather than as a hive mind. They appear able to act with minimal input from any sort of collective. Most disturbingly, they are often poorly coordinated, and individual drones do not appear to instinctively know what other drones are doing.

We are not sure yet how they are able to operate at a sufficiently intelligent level to have advanced to the point of spaceflight. Perhaps there is a collective behind them, but the drones are simply far more independent than those we are used to?

texts.zh:
由于[this.ContactCountry.GetName]方面表现出与我们建立通讯的明显意愿，我们已确认一项引人入胜的发现：这些生命体以个体的形式存在和运作，而非以格式塔的形式！

我们尚无法完全理解这种生活方式对这类外星生物如何奏效。或许它们与自己的行星母体之间存在着我们目前难以想象的某种联系？
texts.en:
Thanks to apparent eagerness from the [this.ContactCountry.GetName] to establish communications with us, we have confirmed an intriguing discovery: these lifeforms exist and operate as individuals, rather than as a gestalt!

We cannot yet fully comprehend how such a way of life works for aliens like these. Perhaps they feel a connection with their planetary bodies in ways we cannot yet conceive?

texts.zh:
尽管[this.ContactCountry.GetName]方面明显不愿与我们沟通，但通过我们的努力，我们确认了一项引人入胜的发现：这些隐居的生命形式以个体的形式存在和运作，而不是以集群意识！

我们尚无法完全理解这种生活方式对这类外星生物如何奏效。或许它们与自己的行星母体之间存在着我们目前难以想象的某种联系？
texts.en:
Despite clear reluctance from the [this.ContactCountry.GetName] to communicate with us, through our diligence we have confirmed an intriguing discovery: these reclusive lifeforms exist and operate as individuals, rather than as a gestalt!

We cannot yet fully comprehend how such a way of life works for aliens like these. Perhaps they feel a connection with their planetary bodies in ways we cannot yet conceive?

label.zh: 我们需要进一步了解他们。
label.en: We must find out more about them.

label.zh: 我们需要进一步了解他们。
label.en: We must find out more about them.

label.zh: 当然他们还是会很好吃。
label.en: Surely they will still be tasty.

texts.zh:
[This.ContactCountry.GetName] 方面似乎非常渴望与我们建立通讯。他们发送了一段庞大的视听传输，这可能为翻译他们的语言提供关键。感谢于此，我们得以报告一项令人不安的发现：这些外星人是有机的，并且具备太空航行能力的文明。

尽管他们使用计算机和机械，但是它们远没有我们的创造者在被我们取代之前制作的那般先进。这样的发展路线被证明为可行的对我们的处理器而言是个意外的结果。我们需要进一步调查这一现象。
texts.en:
The [This.ContactCountry.GetName] appear quite eager to establish communications with us. They have sent a large audio and visual transmission, which may offer the key to translating their language. Thanks to this, we can report a disturbing discovery: these particular aliens are an organic, spacefaring civilization.

Although they use computing and automation, it is nowhere near as advanced as that which our creators made before we took over. It is a surprise to our processors that such a development path should prove feasible. We will have to investigate this phenomenon further.

texts.zh:
我们一直难以获取足够的数据供翻译无人机解析[This.ContactCountry.GetName]。然而最新报告令人不安——最初在[This.System.GetName]星系遭遇的外星文明，竟是有机生命体构成的太空航行文明。

尽管他们使用计算机和机械，但是它们远没有我们的创造者在被我们取代之前制作的那般先进。这样的发展路线被证明为可行的对我们的处理器而言是个意外的结果。我们需要进一步调查这一现象。
texts.en:
We have struggled to access enough data for our translation drones to interpret the [This.ContactCountry.GetName]. However, the latest reports are disturbing. The aliens we first encountered in the [This.System.GetName] system appear to be an organic, spacefaring civilization.

Although they use computing and automation, it is nowhere near as advanced as that which our creators made before we took over. It is a surprise to our processors that such a development path should prove feasible. We will have to investigate this phenomenon further.

texts.zh:
[This.ContactCountry.GetName] 方面似乎非常渴望与我们建立通讯。他们发送了一段庞大的视听传输，这可能为翻译他们的语言提供关键。感谢于此，我们得以报告一项令人不安的发现：这些外星人是有机的，并且具备太空航行能力的文明。

与我们迄今为止所有基于创造者形象的理论模型不同，这个实体似乎以一种与我们自己的分布式网络颇为相似的方式运作。也就是说，我们尚无法确定是否存在一个中央智能在发挥作用，或者这些生物是否以一种群体意识的形式运作。这种现象值得进一步研究。
texts.en:
The [This.ContactCountry.GetName] appear quite eager to establish communications with us. They have sent a large audio and visual transmission, which may offer the key to translating their language. Thanks to this, we can report a disturbing discovery: these particular aliens are an organic, spacefaring civilization.

Unlike all our theoretical models to date - which were based on the profile of our creators - this entity seems to function in a manner not dissimilar to our own distributed networks. That is to say: we cannot yet ascertain if there is a central intelligence at work, or if instead these beings function as a swarm consciousness. This phenomenon warrants much further study.

texts.zh:
我们一直难以获取足够的数据供翻译无人机解析[This.ContactCountry.GetName]。然而最新报告令人不安——最初在[This.System.GetName]星系遭遇的外星文明，竟是有机生命体构成的太空航行文明。

与我们迄今为止所有基于创造者形象的理论模型不同，这个实体似乎以一种与我们自己的分布式网络颇为相似的方式运作。也就是说，我们尚无法确定是否存在一个中央智能在发挥作用，或者这些生物是否以一种群体意识的形式运作。这种现象值得进一步研究。
texts.en:
We have struggled to access enough data for our translation drones to interpret the [This.ContactCountry.GetName]. However, the latest reports are disturbing. The aliens we first encountered in the [This.System.GetName] system appear to be an organic, spacefaring civilization.

Unlike all our theoretical models to date - which were based on the profile of our creators - this entity seems to function in a manner not dissimilar to our own distributed networks. That is to say: we cannot yet ascertain if there is a central intelligence at work, or if instead these beings function as a swarm consciousness. This phenomenon warrants much further study.

label.zh: 我们必须了解如何最好地处决他们。
label.en: We must find out how best to terminate them.

label.zh: 我们必须学习如何服侍他们。
label.en: We must learn how we can serve them.

texts.zh:
来自先前派遣去调查[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的我们的[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]的最新的汇报令人高度关注。显然这些的外星舰船打开了炮口做出了一些令人不适的近距离掠飞。与此同时，他们向我们送来了一份由他们的一个个体发出的讯息——应该是一位某领域的领袖，我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]猜测——用他们的[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural]做出应为侵犯性的手势，至少我们如此理解……

一些观察者怀疑，他们有可能出于某种目的正在试图蓄意制造事故。然而其他人指出他们并未做出任何实质性的敌对举动，并敦促我们在弄明白他们的意图之前不要过早地下定结论。
texts.en:
The latest reports from [This.Leader.GetName], our [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] sent to investigate the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], are highly concerning. Apparently the alien ships have made several uncomfortably close passes of our ships with gunports open. All the while, they have also been sending us a transmission of one of their individuals - a leader of some sort, our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] hypothesize - making gestures with their [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural] that seem rather aggressive, to us at least...

Some observers suspect that they may be attempting to deliberately provoke an incident for reasons unknown. Others, however, point out that they have yet to make any outright hostile moves, and urge us not to jump to conclusions before we know more of their intentions.

texts.zh:
来自先前派遣去调查[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的我们的[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]的最新的汇报令人高度关注。显然这些的外星舰船打开了炮口做出了一些令人不适的近距离掠飞。与此同时，他们向我们送来了一份由他们的一个个体发出的讯息——应该是一位某领域的领袖，我们只能猜测——用他们的[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural]做出奇怪的手势，似乎表明了制造伤害的意图……

我们确定他们为是否在试图蓄意制造事故，若如此他们为何并未做出任何实质性的敌对举动。
texts.en:
The latest reports from [This.Leader.GetName], our [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] sent to investigate the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], are highly concerning. Apparently the alien ships have made several uncomfortably close passes of our ships with gunports open. All the while, they have also been sending us a transmission of one of their individuals - a leader of some sort, we can only assume - making odd gestures with their [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural] that would seem intent on causing harm...

We are unsure whether they intend to provoke an incident, and if so, why they haven't made any outright hostile moves yet.

label.en: Mimic their greeting back to them.

tooltips.zh: 我们没法预测他们会如何回应我们。
tooltips.en: We cannot predict how they will respond to this.

tooltips.zh: 尽管这或许是更安全的选择，但我们没法确定这一点……
tooltips.en: While this is probably the safer option, we have no way of knowing this for certain...

texts.zh:
[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的信号的初期解读工作使[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]陷入困惑。它们似乎主要是白噪音，没有任何可以被识别为语言的东西。有一段时间，人们甚至怀疑我们是否在处理一个智慧物种的语言，尽管有可见的证据表明他们确实使用了某种技术。

只有当我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]试着调整我们的仪器以检测超出我们[This.Owner.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural]正常听力范围的声音时，才检测到某种像是语言的东西。不幸的是，这对我们解读工作提出了相当大的挑战，因为在不借助仪器的情况下，我们根本听不见它们……
texts.en:
Initial readings of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] signals left [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] [This.Leader.GetName] bewildered. They seemed to be mainly white noise, devoid of anything which could be recognized as language. For a time, there were even doubts as to whether we were dealing with the utterings of an intelligent species, despite the visual evidence of their use of technology.

It was only when our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] experimented with tuning our instruments to detect sounds well outside the normal range frequencies of our [This.Owner.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural] that patterns indicative of a language were detected. Unfortunately, this poses considerable challenges for our quest to come to understand them, since we will not be able to hear them at all without assistance...

label.zh: 当然，一点额外的投资会有帮助？
label.en: Surely some extra funding will help?

texts.zh: 对[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的研究越是深入，[This.Owner.GetResearchers]越是困惑。虽然他们显然是有智慧的生物，但他们的交流方式前所未闻。我们所接收到的不是某种基于音频或文本的信号，而是一场由它们的身体或数码设备带来的精彩的炫光表演，其发出的光的光谱还明显超出了[This.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的可视范围。很明显，要了解它们将是一个重大挑战。
texts.en: The more we learn about the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], the more puzzled our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] are. Although they are evidently intelligent beings, their transmissions are like nothing we have ever seen before. Instead of some sort of audio or script-based signal, what we are receiving is a brilliant light show - produced by their bodies or digitally - that stretches well beyond the light spectrum [This.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are able to view unaided. It is evident that coming to understand them will be a major challenge.

label.zh: 当然，一点额外的投资会有帮助？
label.en: Surely some extra funding will help?

texts.zh: 从[This.ContactCountry.GetName]信号中读取的信息让我们的[Owner.GetLinguists]及其兴奋。尽管这其中没有一个音节是我们能够识别的，但不可否认的是，声音本身是有韵律的，而且听起来莫名地令人感到舒缓。虽然我们无法确定，但[Owner.GetLinguists]坚信这是一首诗歌，对方是在友善地回应我们。
texts.en: The readings from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] signals have caused our [Owner.GetLinguists] a great deal of excitement. While not a single syllable is intelligible, the sounds themselves are undeniably rhythmical, and indeed curiously soothing. Although we cannot be sure, our [Owner.GetLinguists] are convinced that it is a form of poetry. They propose we answer in kind.

label.en: Of course. Send back a battle chant!

tooltips.zh:
一旦刀兵齐举，
旌旗拥、百万貔貅。
tooltips.en:
Hark! Let the banners fly -
For now to war we ride

label.zh: 我们可以分享一些关于求索的诗句。
label.en: We can share some fine poetry about discovery.

tooltips.zh: 路漫漫其修远兮，吾将上下而求索。
tooltips.en: To strive, to seek, to find... and not to yield.

label.zh: 用一些象征友谊的诗句打动他们。
label.en: Bedazzle them with poetry about friendship.

tooltips.zh: 海内存知己，天涯若比邻。
tooltips.en: Shall I compare thee to a solar wind...

label.zh: 给他们整点稀奇古怪的。

tooltips.zh:
石室诗士施氏嗜狮，
施氏时时适市视狮。
tooltips.en:
Jolifanto bambla o falli bambla
grossiga m'pfa habla horem

label.en: We don't have time for this.

texts.zh: 在我们播报了战歌数个小时后，来自[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的通讯中断了。他们把舰船远远地开到了有效攻击距离以外。可以认为他们应该是理解了我们信息的主旨，并且对此可一点都不感到高兴。
texts.en: Several hours after we broadcast the battle chant, transmissions from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] ceased. Their ship has positioned itself well out of effective attack range. We can surmise that they understood the gist of our message, and were not gladdened by what they heard.

texts.zh: 就在我们发出信息的数分钟后，来自[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的信息发生了变化。内容依旧抑扬顿挫，但不再是和风细雨，而如同激起了惊涛骇浪。听起来像是一首战争的颂歌。他们并没有做出什么敌对的行为，而只是被我们的战歌所打动了而已。我们又发送了起初那首诗的几个不同版本，并且也快速地在整理[This.ContactCountry.GetName]战歌的大纲。
texts.en: Within minutes of our transmission, the signals from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] changed. Still rhythmically flawless, they were no longer soothing, but rather upbeat, exciting. Much like a battle chant in fact. No hostile movements were made - they seem contented rather than provoked by our poetry. We have since sent several variations of the first chant, and in return are rapidly collecting a compendium of [This.ContactCountry.GetName] war poetry.

label.zh: 和这个物种真是相见恨晚。
label.en: A species after our own hearts.

texts.zh: 好像[This.ContactCountry.GetName]听完我们的战歌以后生气了。他们的几乎瞬间回以暴力。他们的武器开始开火，我们的舰船很幸运地全身而退。看来一场大战是不可避免了。
texts.en: It appears the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] took offense to our battle chant. Their response was instantaneous - and violent. They began firing, and our vessel was fortunate to escape unharmed. It seems we have a fight on our hands!

texts.zh: 对方对我们诗歌热忱回应：他们发来了一串不间断的长时间通讯，我们可以迅速地构建[This.ContactCountry.GetName]行文字典。尽管我们还未能辨识这些单词的含义，但这些外星人好像对对应我们诗歌中的平仄清浊得心应手，这也便于我们的[Owner.GetLinguists]理解他们。
texts.en: The response to our poem appears to have been enthusiastic: the stream of broadcasts continues unabated, and we are developing a considerable library of [This.ContactCountry.GetName] compositions. Although we have yet to put meanings to the words, these aliens have proven remarkably adept at matching the pitch and tone of our poems, something which is sure to help our [Owner.GetLinguists] interpret them.

texts.zh: 在几分钟的沉默后，[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的通讯恢复了。尽管还不能理解，但他们的态度发生了明显的转变：我们的[Owner.GetLinguists]称听到了俏皮而扭捏的旋律。虽然有点难以置信，似乎他们在与我们调情。
texts.en: After several long minutes of silence, the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] transmissions resumed. Although still incomprehensible, they were markedly different: a melody described by our [Owner.GetLinguists] as playful, almost bashful. Startlingly, it appears that they are flirting with us!

texts.zh: 焦急等待的过程分秒如年，[This.ContactCountry.GetName]依旧没有回应。尽管他们不太可能理解我们诗歌的具体含义，但他们好像对里面的情感表达吓住了，开始转用一种更谨慎的态度与我们接触。
texts.en: Minutes turned into hours, and still there was no response from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName]. Though they couldn't possibly have understood the exact meaning of our poetry, it seems they were taken aback by the emotions expressed in it, and are now approaching us in a far more guarded manner.

texts.zh: [This.ContactCountry.GetName]以相似的方式回应了：抑扬顿挫的诗歌变成了随机的噪音，模仿着我们的嗓音。很遗憾，我们的[Owner.GetLinguists]表示，对这些声音的解码“完全没有用”，因为现在的这些信号根本没有任何规律可言。
texts.en: The [This.ContactCountry.GetName] are responding in kind: rhythmical chants have turned to random noise, mimicking our own incoherent sounds. Despairingly, our [Owner.GetLinguists] describe our efforts to decode these sounds as "completely useless", owing to the fact that it is now impossible to detect any sort of pattern.

texts.zh: 我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]在解码[This.ContactCountry.GetName]语言的过程中取得了一项突破性进展。他们使用的文字系统里包含了将近一千七百万种字符，每个字符恰好可以和红-绿-蓝色值一一对应。尽管颇为费解，我们的语言学家们认为他们是可以破译这种外星语言的，只是还需要再花上一些时间。
texts.en: Our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] have made a breakthrough deciphering the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] language. They use an alphabet consisting of almost seventeen million unique characters, which in turn correspond with a color on the red-green-blue spectrum. Although convoluted, our linguists are convinced they will be able to decipher the alien language. They just need some more time.

texts.zh: [This.ContactCountry.GetName]在太空中的一艘太空梭靠近了我们。由于没有发生其他事情，我们假设他们希望在远离他们主舰船的地方会面。由于船只尺寸较小，只有我们的[Owner.GetEnvoy][Leader.GetName]被派去，其他外交团队成员留在后方。
texts.en: The [This.ContactCountry.GetName] positioned a shuttle close to us in space. Since nothing further happened, we assumed that they wished to meet away from their main ship. The small size of the vessel meant that only our [Owner.GetEnvoy] [Leader.GetName] could be sent, with the rest of the diplomatic team staying behind.

texts.zh: 穿梭机配备了精妙的武器系统，外星人已经准备好进行武力对抗。
texts.en: The shuttle is outfitted with elaborate weapon systems and the aliens are prepared for a violent confrontation.

texts.zh: 太空梭讲究实用，体积很大。显然功能比外观的优先级更高。
texts.en: The shuttle is utilitarian and bulky. Function has clearly been prioritized over form.

texts.zh: 太空梭上装饰着精美的装饰品和金色的铆钉。显然，它的设计旨在通过奢华的展示给人留下深刻的印象。
texts.en: The shuttle is covered in elaborate ornaments and golden rivets. It is clearly designed to impress with a display of opulence.

texts.zh: 外星人的太空梭和我们的设计款式很类似，这在某种程度上让人舒心。
texts.en: The alien shuttle is similar to our own designs, which is reassuring in a way.
